title: Tenancy Syntax: Property Conditions & Inspection Valencies

sections.title: Apartment Condition Phrases
sections.content: You know the ending *-ban/-ben* from A1 Unit 5. Tenancy texts use it for the condition of a flat: *megtekintett állapotban* (in the condition seen at the viewing), *jó állapotban van* (is in good condition). A flat is *bútorozott* (furnished) or *gépesített* (with appliances), and you rent it with *bérbe vesz*.

items.spanish: A lakást megtekintett állapotban veszem bérbe a tulajdonostól.
items.english: I rent the apartment in inspected condition from the owner.

items.spanish: A bérleti díj havonta kétszázezer forint, amely nem tartalmazza a rezsit.
items.english: The rent is two hundred thousand forints per month, which does not include utilities.

items.spanish: Az ingatlan teljesen felszerelt konyhával és bútorokkal rendelkezik.
items.english: The property has a fully equipped kitchen and furniture.
